# Data manifest

**Generated by `src/manifest.py`. Do not edit by hand.**

`data/` is gitignored; this file is not. It exists so that "the archived results
reproduce" is checkable rather than asserted: a cache that differs from the one that
produced a published number is detected instead of silently used.

Two of these are **derived artifacts from long refit loops**, not downloads. Regenerating
them is not free, and a `yfinance` re-download years from now is not guaranteed to return
the same history -- which is the whole reason for the hashes.

Regenerate after any deliberate cache change:

```
.venv\Scripts\python.exe src/manifest.py --write
```
